title: 1:1 Preflight — runtime / console / dedicated handoff (Riley)
content:
Quick purpose: notes + loose agenda for tomorrow's 1:1 with Alex (eng lead). Focus: make the handoff from Prototype -> Canary for console route changes, confirm Dedicated capacity plan for Q2, and validate private deploy checklist for three pilot customers.

Topline goals (what I want by EOD Friday):
- Align on canary gating criteria for Console route (latency, error budget, telemetry hooks) — who owns rollbacks?
- Lock Dedicated commit estimate (GPU-hours / anticipated QPS) and ask Eng to sign off on quarterly commit sheet.
- Get Alex to confirm which on-prem steps we need to remove from MVP for Pilot B.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick sync (3m) — wins since last week: hosted API perf improved 9% at p95 after kernel update.
2) Console canary plan (10m) — criteria, runbook, monitoring dashboards, escalation path.
3) Dedicated capacity ask (8m) — numbers, margin for burst, autoscale boundaries.
4) Private pilot readiness (5m) — network/KMS checklist, legal hand-off date.
5) Action items / blockers (4m) — wrap.

Notes to self / talking points:
- Canary gating: propose p95 latency increase <= 5% above baseline AND error rate <= 0.5% over 15m window. If breached, automatic shift to fallback variant for that route. Need confirmation that runtime can expose per-route metrics in 1.2.0. (See GitHub PR #998)
- Telemetry: ask SRE to add token-level cost tag to the console trace (helps product decide whether to throttle heavy routes). Short-term: just include model_id + route_id in traces.
- Rollback ownership: Ops (SRE) will execute rollback, Eng lead owns the decision threshold + canary duration. Confirm with Alex.
- Dedicated ask: baseline 24/7 pool sized for 600 QPS sustained (p50 token length 20), plus 2x burst capacity. Rough math in sheet INF-DED-Q2-estimate (link above). Ask for 10% safety margin for model warmup.
- Private pilot: Pilot A (health-tech customer) requires HSM/KMS integration + SOC2 scoping. Pilot B (banking partner) wants no internet egress and optional on-prem package. Decide which features to cut from MVP for Pilot B to meet timeline.

Open questions to bring up:
- Do we have enough infra runbook coverage to let Solutions Eng run the initial canary? If not, who trains them and when?
- Can runtime team prioritize per-request cache invalidation API? It's currently backlog INF-5067. This affects console experiments.
- Any expected holidays / leaves next two weeks that affect the Dedicated commit timeline?

Draft action items (assign during 1:1):
- Alex: confirm gating thresholds + sign off on canary runbook (due 2026-03-12).
- Riley: publish runbook to Confluence and ping SRE for trace tags (due 2026-03-11).
- Miguel: update Dedicated estimate spreadsheet with adjusted burst numbers and share with finance (due 2026-03-13).
- Asha: call with Pilot B security lead to trim MVP features (schedule 30m this week).
- Eng: triage INF-5067 and give ETA (ask in sync, target: 2026-03-19).

Scratch notes (rough):
- If canary fails, fallback to smaller model or to hosted fallback route? Discuss cost vs quality tradeoff.
- Consider adding a short client-facing note in console changelog if route behavior differs >1%.
- Remind Alex about quarterly OKR mapping: this canary + Dedicated commit map to OKR-2.

Prep checklist (things I want on my screen during 1:1):
- p95 latency and error rate charts for route /console/v1/generate for last 48h
- canary runbook link + runbook checklist (toggle rollback steps highlighted)
- Dedicated estimate sheet with units and assumptions (GPU type, spot vs reserved)
- Draft private deploy checklist (network, KMS, onboarding steps)

Tiny lines to remember (quick quips to drop in meeting):
- "Prefer automated fallback to manual ops when safe — reduces decision latency."
- "Dedicated commit is a bet on predictable throughput; let's be conservative on warmup."

Follow-up note (post-1:1 template):
- Send 1-paragraph summary of decisions + concrete next steps to Alex, copy SRE and Eng. Include links to runbook, spreadsheet, and the ticket numbers.

Unresolved items to escalate if we don't resolve this week:
- INF-5067 per-request cache invalidation priority.
- Confirmation that runtime 1.2.0 exposes per-route metrics. If not, propose temporary export via edge proxy.

Back-of-envelope numbers (for quick convo) — keep light:
- Current p95 baseline for route: 420ms (model heavy), goal for canary: <= 441ms (<=5% increase)
- Error rate baseline: 0.08% -> allow up to 0.5% for short window
- Dedicated Q2 commit: ~1400 GPU-hours / week (guesstimate) -> convert to dollars later in finance sheet

End notes: keep this doc messy. Will copy cleaned action list into Confluence after meeting.

-- Riley
